newsitem.title: USA: Schnitzer, Proler waiting period ends.
newsitem.headline: Schnitzer, Proler waiting period ends.

text.p: Schnitzer Steel Industries Inc and Proler International Corp said on Monday the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 has ended, clearing the way for Schnitzer to proceed with its acquisition of Proler.
In a statement, Schnitzer said its tender offer expires on Friday, Nov. 29, and it is making arrangements to begin making payments for tendered shares as soon as Monday, Dec. 2.
In September, the companies agreed for Schnitzer to acquire Proler for $7.50 a share in cash. In November, the price was increased to $9.00 a share in cash.
